rust.name: src/pointers.rs:103:31: replace match guard !line.is_empty() && line.chars().all(|c| c.is_ascii_digit()) with true in repo_path
rust.why: The tests cover a numeric suffix and `Kind::ALL`, whose prefix still fails path recognition after stripping. A nonnumeric suffix on a recognizable path would expose the change.

rust.name: src/pointers.rs:134:14: replace > with >= in adrs
rust.why: The ADR fixtures omit a delimiter followed by no digits, such as `ADR-` at the end of a line, which would now produce a fault.

rust.name: src/pointers.rs:134:54: replace + with - in adrs
rust.why: This corrupts the reported `pointer` for a missing ADR, while the tests assert its `missing` path, file, and line.

rust.name: src/pointers.rs:19:5: replace extensions -> String with String::new()
